# utils.solver.flux_divergence { #climatecritters.utils.solver.flux_divergence }

```python
utils.solver.flux_divergence(face_fluxes, dz)
```

Compute finite-volume tendency from face fluxes and layer thicknesses.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**face_fluxes**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [([array](`array`) - [like](`like`), [shape](`shape`)([n_layers](`n_layers`) + 1))]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Fluxes at cell faces.

<code>[**dz**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [([array](`array`) - [like](`like`), [shape](`shape`)([n_layers](`n_layers`)))]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Layer thicknesses.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**tendency**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [([ndarray](`ndarray`), [shape](`shape`)([n_layers](`n_layers`)))]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Per-layer tendency ``-(flux_out - flux_in) / dz``.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ValueError](`ValueError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If ``face_fluxes`` does not have length ``n_layers + 1``.
